This site hosts the **asynchronous sessions** for 36104.

Every code cell runs Python in your browser.

Edit the code and press **Run Code**.

## How to use these pages

1. Work through the parts of each session in order.
2. Run each code cell as you reach it; edit and re-run to experiment.
3. Where a page has an exercise, attempt it before using the hints, and
   check the solution only after making your own attempt.

Your work here is **not saved** when you close the tab.
